checks.name: database_backend
checks.reason: staging/production requires PostgreSQL; development may use SQLite

checks.name: database_password_not_placeholder
checks.reason: database password must be supplied and must not be a known placeholder

checks.name: demo_auth_disabled
checks.reason: demo credentials must be disabled in staging/production

checks.name: cors_allowlist_explicit
checks.reason: staging/production requires a non-wildcard CORS allowlist

checks.name: production_cors_uses_https
checks.reason: production browser origins must use HTTPS

checks.name: production_cors_excludes_localhost
checks.reason: production browser origins must not resolve to local development hosts

checks.name: redis_configured
checks.reason: staging/production requires Redis for background engineering jobs

checks.name: latest_migration_present
checks.reason: the latest automation leasing migration must ship with the image

checks.name: non_demo_identity_provider_integrated
checks.reason: strict profiles require the feature-flagged OIDC issuer, audience, HTTPS JWKS URL, and RS256 validation

checks.name: external_dispatch_uses_https
checks.reason: enabled n8n dispatch must use an HTTPS webhook endpoint

checks.name: external_dispatch_secret_strong
checks.reason: enabled n8n dispatch requires a non-placeholder signing secret of at least 32 characters

checks.name: external_dispatch_test_recipient_only
checks.reason: prototype external dispatch must remain restricted to synthetic test recipients

claim_boundary: Runtime configuration validation for a deployment-shaped engineering prototype. It is not a security certification, HIPAA claim, clinical validation, or evidence of production healthcare readiness.
